name: career-skills
description: Job-hunting skills for Claude Code — a domain-agnostic career methodology engine, not a stale question bank. 6 skills covering the full pipeline, works in Chinese or English. Uses live web for real postings / JDs and never fabricates employers, titles, numbers, or links.

plugins.name: career-skills
plugins.description: 6 Claude skills for the full job hunt: find real openings (role-finder) → decode a JD (jd-analyzer) → plan what to learn (gap-planner) → turn raw experience into role language (experience-mapper) → polish résumé bullets (bullet-builder) → assemble a tailored résumé (resume-tailor). Works in Chinese or English, result-first, with a shared no-fabrication red line and live-web sourcing for real jobs / JDs.
